description: Join us for a beautiful 90 minute evening cruise of Boston Harbor under the stars. View Boston’s beautiful skyline of lights. Whether you’re ending your evening onboard or starting your night out, come Sea Boston with Mass Bay Lines.
what_is_included: - Drinks are available for pre-purchase and also available to purchase on board
